title: Arranging for Marva Louis
summary: Whaley arranged Marva Louis's act, she got $500 a performance, and made a bet she could last six months in show business.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: I was up in Boston. And Marva Louis, I arranged all her music, and she --
She was the lady that married Joe Louis, right?
Yeah, Marva Louis. She used to get $500 a performance. She went down to Philadelphia, and it was a small
room, and then people would try to tear her clothes off. But she went through with it. She made a bet with Joe, I think, or somebody, that she could last six months in show business. And she did.
Yeah. She made a lot of money. $500 a week.
